resources.string: Every page keeps its size and look. Text stays editable in text boxes where it was on the page; lines, shapes and pictures are kept as pictures. Scanned pages stay as pictures with searchable text read on your device.

Each page becomes a slide that keeps its look. Text stays editable in text boxes where it was on the page; lines, shapes and pictures are kept as pictures. Scanned pages stay as pictures with searchable text read on your device.
Tables become rows and cells, one sheet per page that has them. Numbers stay numbers, so you can sum them.
Layout was simplified: text, headings, lists and tables are editable, but fonts, columns, drawings and pictures were not carried over.
